title: The app's external sign-in flow: begin, browser, loopback, finish
spec: chat_session::begin_external sends one BeginExternal frame and returns the ExternalStart (issuer, client id, authorization endpoint, nonce; Debug hides the nonce), None for Refused, SignInProtocol for any other reply and an Io error if the server closes; ChatSession::finish_external opens a session with the FinishExternal opening. signed_in and ServerEndpoint expose both over a fresh device connection. external_flow::run asks the server to begin (NotOffered if it has no provider), makes a PKCE pair and a state from two separate random draws, listens on the loopback, opens the browser at the provider's code-flow URL (client id, redirect URI, scope, state, the server's nonce, S256 challenge), waits for the redirect (Loopback errors on timeout or a provider error, Browser if the browser cannot be opened), and finishes with the code, the verifier matching the challenge, and the same redirect URI (Server on refusal).
